title: Outdoor Kitchen & Porch Stone Ideas | July 2025 GenStone Projects
description: See real GenStone outdoor kitchen and porch projects from July 2025. Explore backyard and curb appeal upgrades with easy DIY stone ideas.
text: GenStone Project Highlights – July 2025 Outdoor Kitchen & Porch Projects Amanda Lombard Director July projects leaned heavily into outdoor living, with homeowners upgrading entertaining spaces and front-of-home details that make an immediate visual impact. From custom outdoor kitchens to refreshed porch columns, these projects show how GenStone adds texture, durability, and a finished stone look without the weight or mess of masonry. It’s beautiful and has updated our home.” — Lori FAQs Ask Away. We've Heard it All. Can GenStone be installed indoors and outdoors? Yes. GenStone panels are designed for both interior and exterior applications. They are commonly used for accent walls, fireplace surrounds, entryways, garages, outdoor kitchens, and exterior facades. Evan Trevenna Senior Project Coordinator How long does a typical GenStone project take? Most GenStone projects can be completed in a single afternoon or weekend depending on the size of the space. Because the panels are lightweight and designed to interlock, homeowners can install them much faster than traditional masonry stone. Courtney Mintz Project Coordinator Do I need special tools to install GenStone panels? No special masonry tools are required. Most projects can be completed using common tools like a circular saw, screws, a drill, and a level. The panels are easy to cut and install using standard woodworking tools. Kevin O'Dwyer General Manager How do I estimate how much GenStone I need for my project? You can use the GenStone material calculator or contact a Project Coordinator for a full estimate. Most homeowners measure the square footage of the wall area and then account for corners, trim, and a small 5% waste factor.
